description: A task editor panel for the Gantt chart. Allows editing selected task properties and dependencies.

parameters.name: Task
parameters.description: The task being edited.

parameters.name: CanMoveUp
parameters.description: True when the task can move one place up among its siblings. Disables the Move up command; both move flags false hide the pair (there is nothing a move could do without a reorder handler upstream).

parameters.name: CanMoveDown
parameters.description: True when the task can move one place down among its siblings. Disables the Move down command.

parameters.name: Tabbed
parameters.description: The tabbed presentation (the side sheet of a tablet container): the panel draws no header (the sheet owns the title and the close button) and splits its sections into the tabs Detail | Attachments | Comments | History. Default false is the single scrolling form of the desktop panel.

parameters.name: History
parameters.description: Audit entries; the History tab shows those whose EntityRef.EntityId is the edited task.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Zone the History tab shows its times in. Null: the machine zone.

parameters.name: ActiveTimerTaskId
parameters.description: Id of the task whose timer is currently running. Null if none.

parameters.name: AllTasks
parameters.description: All tasks for parent selection.

parameters.name: Dependencies
parameters.description: Existing dependencies.

parameters.name: OnAttachmentRemoved
parameters.description: Fires when the user removes an attachment (by attachment Id).

parameters.name: OnAttachmentUpload
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects a file to attach.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the user closes the panel via the close button.

parameters.name: OnCommentAdded
parameters.description: Fires when the user submits a new comment.

parameters.name: OnDependencyAdded
parameters.description: Fires when a new dependency is added.

parameters.name: OnDependencyRemoved
parameters.description: Fires when a dependency is removed (by its Id).

parameters.name: OnDescriptionChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the description textarea changes (live).

parameters.name: OnTaskUpdated
parameters.description: Fires when the task is saved with valid data.

parameters.name: OnTimerStarted
parameters.description: Fires when the user starts the timer for this task (arg = taskId).

parameters.name: OnTimerStopped
parameters.description: Fires when the user stops the timer (arg = taskId + completed log entry).

parameters.name: OnStatusChanged
parameters.description: Fires on Save when the Status field was changed (arg = task id + the new status); like the priority, the status is a draft until Save and Cancel reverts it. TmGantt applies it to the task and raises its own OnStatusChanged.

parameters.name: OnAction
parameters.description: Fires when the user picks a command of the Actions section (mark done, add above / below / child, duplicate, delete). The section renders only when the host handles this callback.

parameters.name: IsOverloaded
parameters.description: When true the Progress section states that one of the task's assignees is over capacity (read-only).

parameters.name: BaselineTask
parameters.description: The task's entry in the active baseline; when set the Progress section shows the start / end deviation from it (read-only).

parameters.name: Breadcrumb
parameters.description: Optional breadcrumb shown above the task title in the panel header.
